hash-map.q: Explain what a hash map is in two sentences.
hash-map.text: A hash map is a data structure that stores key-value pairs by using a hash function to compute an index into an array of buckets or slots. This allows for highly efficient average-case time complexity of O(1) for inserting, deleting, and searching for elements.
